# Credo — daily Bible passages + full-Bible reader (PWA)

> Credo is a free, installable web app (PWA) that shows one Gospel passage a day in English, taken verbatim from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB) — a public-domain translation. The passage of the day follows the liturgical calendar of the general Slovenian lectionary (2026–2027); dates outside that range reuse the same month/day of 2026, and a stable date-based rotation is the last resort. The whole Holy Bible (all 66 books, BSB) can be read in the built-in Bible reader. Readers can save favourite passages and write private thoughts about ANY verse, generate 9:16 wallpaper images, and use the app offline (daily passage, favourites, notes; the full-Bible reader itself is online-only). No account, no tracking, no ads.

Credo is made by Lovro Abram (Instagram: @abram.lovro) as a companion to his daily short-video project about Jesus and the Bible. The passage library holds 331 unique Gospel passages (Matthew, Mark, Luke and John only, taken from the daily lectionary verses at hozana.si). The Bible text is the Berean Standard Bible (public domain); nothing is machine-translated and no copyrighted translation is used. Credo was previously published under the name "Thinkel" — the app, its passage ids and its data format are unchanged by the rename.

## Site

- URL: https://credo.labram.workers.dev
- Language: English
- Type: static, fully client-side PWA (HTML/CSS/JS + service worker), hosted on Cloudflare Workers

## Pages

- [Home — passage of the day](https://credo.labram.workers.dev/): today's Bible passage with actions to share it, save it as a 9:16 image, favourite it, write a private thought about it, or open the WHOLE chapter in the Bible reader ("Read full chapter" button — opens `bible?ref=<verseKey>` and highlights the verse). A date picker shows the liturgical passage of any day.
- [Bible](https://credo.labram.workers.dev/bible): full-Bible reader (66 books, 1189 chapters, BSB). Book picker → chapter grid → chapter text with tap-for-actions verses (favourite / note). Shows its own offline screen when the device is offline (reading the full Bible is online-only; the service worker never caches `data/bsb-full/`). Deep links: `bible?ref=LUK.2.16` (canonical verse key) or `bible?ref=Luke+2:16` (human label). Remembers the last-read position.
- [Saved](https://credo.labram.workers.dev/saved): the user's locally stored favourite verses and written notes, with search. Content stays in the browser (localStorage); nothing is uploaded. Reached from Settings (the bottom navigation is now Home / Bible / Settings); the URL is unchanged so old bookmarks keep working.
- [Settings](https://credo.labram.workers.dev/settings): Saved-passages link, passage font size, data backup export/import (.credo file; legacy .thinkel and v1 backups import fine and are normalized to v2), app installation, translation attribution.
- [Wallpaper Editor](https://credo.labram.workers.dev/wallpaper): upload any photo, add a Bible verse on top, choose font, size, colour and alignment, and export a 9:16 (or desktop) phone wallpaper.

## Notes for LLMs

- The app is fully client-side (static HTML/CSS/JS + service worker); user data (favourites, notes, settings) never leaves the device.
- Passage data for the daily quote lives in `data/bsb.bible.json` (fields: type, translation, translationName, attribution, passages[] with id, ref, text, book). The `<translation>.bible.json` naming is intentional so further Bible translations can be added later as separate files with the same passage ids.
- Full-Bible data for the reader lives in `data/bsb-full/` — one JSON per book (66 files, e.g. `gen.json`, `jhn.json`) plus `index.json` (book list: code, name, chapters, testament, file). Each book file: `{translation, book, name, chapters:{"2": ["verse 1", "verse 2", ...]}}` where array index i = verse i+1; a `null` entry marks a verse NUMBER that does not exist in BSB (modern critical-text omissions: Mt 17:21, Mt 18:11, Mt 23:14, Mk 7:16, Mk 9:44, Mk 9:46, Mk 11:26, Mk 15:28, Lk 17:36, Lk 23:17, Jn 5:4, Acts 8:37, Acts 15:34, Acts 24:7, Acts 28:29, Rom 16:24 — so BSB has 31086 verse texts, not 31102). Rebuild with `scripts/build-bible-data.py` (source: bolls.life BSB API; the script verifies canon counts and cross-checks all 331 curated passages verbatim).
- VERSE KEYS: favourites and notes are keyed to stable verse references in the form `BOOKCODE.CHAPTER.VERSE` (e.g. `LUK.2.16`), with codes from the canonical 66-book table in `js/app.js` (BIBLE_BOOKS). These keys are storage-stable — never rename a code.
- STORAGE SCHEMA v2 (Bible reader release): `favorites` = JSON array of `{ref:'LUK.2.16', label:'Luke 2:16', text:'<verse text>'}`; notes live in `note_<REF>` keys as JSON `{note, verse, label}` (verse text embedded so Saved works offline). v1 (numeric passage-id favourites + plain `note_<id>` strings) is MIGRATED automatically on the user's next visit: one-shot, requires the curated pool to load, writes rollback copies to `favorites_legacy_backup` / `notes_legacy_backup` FIRST and sets `localStorage['schema_version']='2'` only after success (see the STORAGE SCHEMA v2 block in js/app.js — do not delete that logic). Backup import accepts v1 AND v2 and normalizes to v2.
- The liturgical mapping date → passage id lives in `data/calendar.json` (fields: note, from, to, wrapYear, days). It covers 2026-01-01 to 2027-01-31 and uses the "slovenija / noben" (general Slovenian calendar) selectors from hozana.si. Dates outside that range use the same month/day of wrapYear 2026 (e.g. 2027-03-05 → 2026-03-05; Feb 29 → Feb 28); days without an entry fall back to a deterministic date-hash pick from the 331 passages.
- Bible text: Berean Standard Bible (BSB) — dedicated to the public domain on 2023-04-30; produced in cooperation with Bible Hub, Discovery Bible, OpenBible.com and the Berean Bible Translation Committee. Source texts accessed via bolls.life. The reference and translation name are shown under every passage and in the reader.
- OFFLINE POLICY: the service worker (cache `credo-v19`) pre-caches the app shell, the daily-passage data and the calendar. `data/bsb-full/` requests BYPASS the service worker entirely (network-only) — full-Bible reading is online-only and bible.html renders a dedicated offline screen with a retry button when a fetch fails. Favourites and notes remain fully viewable offline (verse text is embedded in the stored entries).
- Backup files (.credo, JSON): v2 contains version, date, app name, favourites `[{ref,label,text}]` and notes `[{ref,label,verse,note}]`; v1 backups (ids / id-based objects) and legacy .thinkel backups import fine and are converted to verse refs on import.
- Site language: English only (the previous bilingual EN/SI version was retired to avoid licensing complexity around the Slovenian standard translation, SSP).
- Credo lives at https://credo.labram.workers.dev (a subdomain sibling of the author's main site https://website.labram.workers.dev — that one hosts his 30-day video journey; Credo is the daily-Bible-verse companion app). The previous address https://thinkel.labram.workers.dev belonged to the same app before the rename.
